'''Galactic Sustainability Institute''' was a subsidiary division of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] founded to protect [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s most valuable resources. Their mission was to ensure that worlds could survive even in the face of war, overconsumption, political unrest, or unexpected disasters.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Galactic Sustainability Institute}}</ref>
